blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Dengue cases in Agusan del Sur rose by 329 in the latest provincial health update, pushing total infections to 4,350 while deaths remained at 22, according to the Provincial Health Office (PHO). The PHO’s Dengue Situationer on Nov. 23 showed cumulative cases climbing from 4,021 the previous week, with a 0.50-percent case fatality rate. Rosario posted the highest total at 890 cases (up from 859) and the highest attack rate at 17 per 1,000 population, followed by San Francisco with 578 (from 543), Bayugan City with 476 (from 437), and Loreto with 470 (from 425).
